payload.purpose_context: The implement command file is a 2,300-line hotspot with heavy churn and tests that patch its internals. This mission moves its decisions into the existing workspace, lane, status and dependency seams without changing behaviour, removes the meta-derived coordination fallback (#5232), and moves the tests onto those seams.
payload.purpose_tldr: Split the implement command into a thin CLI over seam-owned phases so later fixes in this area are cheap to make and pin with tests.

options: A: fail closed on any context-resolution error
B: write-shaped placement seam, fail closed only when it cannot resolve
payload.question: How should #5232 remove the C-004 meta-derived fallback: (A) make placement_ref required and fail closed on any context-resolution error, or (B) resolve through the write-shaped placement seam and fail closed only when that seam cannot resolve?

payload.final_answer: B: write-shaped placement seam, fail closed only when it cannot resolve. Resolved autonomously under the operator's semi-automatic brief (fold #5232 in, stop only on a real behaviour-change decision). Option B keeps the degrade owned by the placement seam, does not newly refuse flat missions or the unmaterialized window, and follows the mission_record_analysis precedent (#5113). Guard: a characterization test must show the write-shaped ref equals the read-shaped placement_ref wherever the latter resolves; if they diverge in a reachable case, escalate to the operator.
